subject.title: fix: generated image previews return unauthorized

question: Should session-bound managed-image bytes returned by artifacts.download follow the existing operator.read artifact contract, or remain an operator.admin-only exception?
rationale: Both choices are technically implementable, but this determines whether ordinary read-scoped clients can receive Gateway-local generated bytes and therefore needs explicit ownership of the security and compatibility boundary.

options.title: Use operator.read
options.body: Allow managed-image bytes for read-scoped artifact callers after all session, record, URL, transcript, and coordinate bindings pass, matching the existing artifact contract.

options.title: Require operator.admin
options.body: Keep managed-image bytes admin-only and update the protocol, PR description, UI behavior, tests, and user-facing failure handling to make that exception explicit.

recommendation.title: Use operator.read
recommendation.body: Allow managed-image bytes for read-scoped artifact callers after all session, record, URL, transcript, and coordinate bindings pass, matching the existing artifact contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent managed outgoing-image HTTP and Gateway runtime history makes vincentkoc the strongest available routing candidate for this authorization boundary.
